verdict.rationale: Kintsugi syncs transactions and computes nexus by looking back across the trailing year, and exposes a nexus list endpoint, supporting economic nexus tracking against thresholds — but this evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and none of the pack explicitly describes proactive pre-crossing alerts (only that it 'determines nexus' and 'finds exposure you didn't know you had,' which reads more retrospective than predictive). missing for 10: explicit documentation of real-time threshold alerts/notifications before a crossing occurs, per-state/country threshold configuration detail, and independent confirmation the monitoring works as claimed.
